## Trust-boundary impact

Check every applicable statement:

- [ ] I identified any change to provenance, schemas, verification, confidence, authority, redaction, or human review.
- [ ] Observable data, human-readable interpretation, inference, restricted information, and unavailable telemetry remain distinguishable.
- [ ] This change does not claim access to private chain-of-thought or literal neural thoughts.
- [ ] Deterministic execution is not described as thinking or judgment.
- [ ] New or changed claims link to their supporting context and state what remains unavailable.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private instruction, personal data, or restricted dataset is included.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] `npm run audit:dependencies` passes locally.
- [ ] Keyboard, contrast, responsive layout, and reduced-motion behavior were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated when public behavior changed.
- [ ] I reviewed and take responsibility for any AI-assisted code or content.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` line.
